text: The Riemann integral ∫ₐᵇ f(x)dx exists (for a bounded function) iff:
choices: the set of discontinuities of f has measure zero (Lebesgue's criterion)
explanation: Lebesgue's criterion: a bounded function on [a,b] is Riemann integrable iff it is continuous almost everywhere (its discontinuities form a null set).
